candidateOrder: Must contain Ultimate visual donor; if absent from all 159 original decks, contain an Ultimate of target Specialty

selectionPolicy.viability: Opponent-eligible (owner is not Player) and containing a Rookie, Champion and Ultimate; never consume an Option or a different level.
fallbackOrder: Exact visual donor whenever present (including cross-Specialty donors)
For a missing slot, choose one target-Specialty card of that level, descending copy count then ascending card ID
If no target-Specialty donor exists at that level, choose its most populous Specialty, tie ascending Specialty ID, then descending copies and ascending card ID
selectionPolicy.copyPolicy: Replace every copy of exactly one donor per R/C/U slot. Never aggregate multiple donors into more than four copies.
